svg.text: WORLDENGINE / POSTCARDS + WIDGETS
One-page implementation brief · proposal v1 · 6 Oct 2026
Type and hierarchy
System sans (SF in app), place 20–28 pt; condition 15–17; credits 11–12. Use tabular time.
Night text white on a quiet opaque plate.
Frames and safe areas
Exports: 1080×1080, 1080×1350, 1080×1920. Keep type/credits 32 px inside edges; classic 55
px. Story reserve 240 px top/bottom. Reframe camera per ratio; do not crop out regional
landmarks.
Attribution
© OpenStreetMap contributors stays visible whenever world imagery appears. Use official
Apple Weather combinedMarkLightURL / combinedMarkDarkURL, unmodified and proportional. Show
legalPageURL link. Static images print a readable legal URL and travel with a linked detail
page.
Weather transformation
Add “Weather visualization modified from Apple Weather data.” Provider attribution is a
runtime dependency, not a baked invented logo. Alerts, if added, retain issuing agency and
event link. These samples are illustrative conditions, not actual Apple observations.
Widget contract
Native text over cached scene, explicit capture time and stale state. Small/medium/large
adapt to system dimensions. No exemption for tiny widgets is established: keep mark and
Legal affordance, verify provider treatment; otherwise use a non-weather launcher.
Engine output
Place display name; local timestamp and timezone; weather condition / temperature / units;
observation and capture ages; season; precipitation phase/intensity; sun and moon
azimuth/elevation plus phase; camera target/framing; snapshot variants; OSM credit;
official weather assets and legal URL; offline state.
Validation before shipping
Test localized place names, Dynamic Type, tinted/monochrome widgets, contrast, all crops,
stale data and legal links on device. Generated scenes are direction studies, not measured
geography, ephemeris or performance results.
